arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ إِذا جاءَ نَصرُ اللَّهِ وَالفَتحُ
translation: When Allah's succour and the triumph cometh

arabic: وَرَأَيتَ النّاسَ يَدخُلونَ فى دينِ اللَّهِ أَفواجًا
transliteration: Waraayta alnnasa yadkhuloona fee deeni Allahi afwajan
translation: And thou seest mankind entering the religion of Allah in troops

arabic: فَسَبِّح بِحَمدِ رَبِّكَ وَاستَغفِرهُ إِنَّهُ كانَ تَوّابًا
transliteration: Fasabbih bihamdi rabbika waistaghfirhu innahu kana tawwaban
translation: Then hymn the praises of thy Lord, and seek forgiveness of Him. Lo! He is ever ready to show mercy
